description: Website check from Levered, no sign-in. Takes a business website and the email where Levered sends the findings. It checks only what anyone can see from outside: the site and its competitors, which tracking and conversion tags are set up, Google and Meta ads found in the public ad libraries, each path from an ad or the homepage to the form, call or booking and where it breaks, SEO basics and AI-search visibility. It reports what it checked and up to three problems it could verify. If none stood out, it says so. It explains the next step. A Levered marketer then reviews it and emails what Levered would do first. Nothing is charged, no form on the site is submitted, and nothing changes on the site.

email.description: Where Levered sends the findings. Use the address the person gave you.

website.description: The business website, for example example.com or https://example.com.
